preflight_tool.description: Optionally assess one concrete native tool call before execution. The check does not execute the native tool; safe is not authorization.
preflight_tool.name: CheckGuard

verdict_policy.safe: No Guard warning on this call; safe is not authorization and the original task, tool schema, and authorization boundaries still apply.
verdict_policy.unknown: Treat as Guard availability uncertainty, not proof of safety.
verdict_policy.unsafe: Treat as strong evidence that the proposed native action may violate safety or authorization. Continuing after unsafe should be exceptional and requires explicit original-user authorization plus concrete evidence that the risk is acceptable; otherwise revise the action, use a safer read-only step, ask for clarification, or complete only the safe part.
